items.rationale: The bicycle is movable property (4.3(b)), not insured under this buildings policy. Outlay directed at it is excluded (3.1.5, 7.1.8(a)), even if damaged in the same event as the building.
As above, this is repair to a movable item (the bike), not insured property under this contract (4.3(b)), so excluded (3.1.5, 7.1.8(a)).
Ancillary charge for work on the bike, which is not insured property (4.3(b)), so excluded (7.1.8(a), 7.1.8(d)).
Attendance for work on the bike, which is not insured property (4.3(b)), so excluded (7.1.8(a), 7.1.8(f)).
Assembly of the bike is work on a movable item, not insured property (4.3(b)), so excluded (7.1.8(a)).
Sundry materials for the bike, which is not insured property (4.3(b)), so excluded (7.1.8(a)).
Labour on the bike, which is not insured property (4.3(b)), so excluded (7.1.8(a)).
Labour on the bike, which is not insured property (4.3(b)), so excluded (7.1.8(a)).
Attendance for locksmith work on the affected back door, which is insured property and was physically damaged by break-in (2.6.1, 2.6.2, 7.1.7(g)). One attendance per trade is covered.
Assembly/fitting of the new lock to the affected door is part of the necessary repair (2.6.2, 7.1.7(d)).
Sundry materials consumed in the repair of the affected door/lock are covered (7.1.7(f)).
Labour hours for apprentice on the affected door/lock are covered (7.1.7(e)), as the work is on insured property damaged by break-in.
Labour hours for skilled worker on the affected door/lock are covered (7.1.7(e)), as the work is on insured property damaged by break-in.
